description: Base wallet intelligence: holdings, activity, counterparties, labels. One-call Base wallet profile: ETH and major token holdings (USDC, WETH, USDT, DAI, cbBTC, cbETH, AERO, EURC) with USD values, total USD, nonce (lifetime sent tx count), EOA vs contract (incl. EIP-7702 smart account), recent ERC20 transfers in/out over ~5,000 blocks (~3h) with net flow, top counterparties labeled where known (Uniswap, Aerodrome, 1inch, 0x, Aave, Seaport, bridges), and a simple wallet type. Free public data, deterministic, no LLM. Example output: {"address":"0x…","isContract":false,"nonce":1200,"ethBalance":"0.5","totalUsd":2100.4,"holdings":[{"symbol":"USDC","amount":"900","usd":900}],"recent":{"blocks":5000,"transfersIn":3,"transfersOut":5},"counterparties":[{"address":"0x6ff5…","label":"Uniswap Universal Router","count":4}],"walletType":". Price: $0.0096 USDC on Base via x402 (pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).
name: base_wallet_profile
